_comment: Forward-compatible ecosystem registry. The page renders official plugins + the founding cohort TODAY; as community plugins arrive it grows into a capability-organised directory (group by `category`, tier within each: official > recommended > community) with NO page rewrite — just more rows here. `categories` is the published taxonomy a plugin slots into. `tier`: official (Pyxle team) | recommended (community, reviewed, the suggested default for its category) | community (listed, meets standards). `contract` names the capability interface a plugin implements, so providers in one category become swappable by config — the ecosystem's real differentiator. `version` is the released version shown in the directory (bump on release). `highlights` are the 3–4 short spec lines the card renders — labels, not sentences.

plugins.name: pyxle-db
highlights: SQLite · PostgreSQL · MySQL, one explicit-SQL API
migration CLI — checksum migrator or Alembic
plugins.description: Database for Pyxle over SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL — an explicit-SQL API or an optional SQLAlchemy ORM, both with request-scoped injection, automatic transactions, and a migration CLI (checksum migrator or Alembic).

plugins.name: pyxle-auth
highlights: wildcard RBAC · scoped API tokens · request guards
plugins.description: Email + password accounts on argon2id — sliding sessions, password-reset and verification flows, wildcard RBAC, scoped API tokens, and request guards. Fail-secure by default.

plugins.name: pyxle-mail
plugins.description: Transactional email over a swappable MailProvider contract — console, SMTP, and Resend providers, sender defaults, and fail-loud config. The mailer pyxle-auth's reset and verification flows hand their tokens to.
